description: This file defines the `BidiExecutionContext` class, which implements an execution context delegate for running and evaluating JavaScript in a bidirectional protocol environment, such as in browser automation or testing frameworks. It includes methods for evaluating expressions, handling remote objects, getting properties, and managing element references within a remote execution context.

classes.name: BidiExecutionContext
classes.description: Implements an execution context delegate for bidirectional communication, enabling evaluation and manipulation of scripts and DOM elements within a remote browser environment.

methods.name: rawEvaluateJSON
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression in the remote context and returns the result deserialized into native JavaScript objects.

methods.name: rawEvaluateHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression and returns a handle to the result, allowing further interaction with the remote object.

methods.name: evaluateWithArguments
methods.description: Calls a function with provided arguments and returns either a value or a handle based on the `returnByValue` flag.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Retrieves the enumerable properties of a remote object handle as a map of property name to handle.

methods.name: releaseHandle
methods.description: Disposes of a remote object handle, freeing resources on the remote side.

methods.name: nodeIdForElementHandle
methods.description: Gets the shared node ID corresponding to an element handle.

methods.name: remoteObjectForNodeId
methods.description: Retrieves a DOM element handle for a given remote node ID.

methods.name: contentFrameIdForFrame
methods.description: Gets the frame ID for the content window of an iframe element handle.

methods.name: frameIdForWindowHandle
methods.description: Gets the frame ID for a window handle.

methods.name: _remoteValueForReference
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve a remote value for a given reference.

methods.name: _rawCallFunction
methods.description: Internal method to invoke a function in the remote context with given arguments, handling responses and exceptions.
